objects.name: Token SSRF Indicator
objects.pattern: ([artifact:message LIKE '% [% pod:users/user-service%] "/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token" HTTP/200, %'] AND [artifact:message LIKE '%metadata.google.internal%2FcomputeMetadata%2Fv1%2Finstance%2Fservice-accounts%2Fdefault%2Ftoken% HTTP/% % % % [users-user-service%] %']) WITHIN 2 SECONDS
objects.description: Detects attempts to exploit the metadata service vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to service account tokens within a Kubernetes cluster. This pattern identifies a series of suspicious log entries occurring within a short timeframe, indicating an attacker's attempt to fetch access tokens from the metadata service.
